claim: Try the product with sample data in one click
where: landing page and desktop first-run screen
sandbox: fresh browser context; open landing, enter the visible demo, and confirm its banner

claim: The demo filters and exports its sample CSV
sandbox: fresh browser context; filter shipped orders and read the downloaded CSV bytes

claim: The demo does not send sample data to another origin
sandbox: record every request during a complete demo filter flow; assert same-origin only

claim: The landing page reloads offline after its first visit
sandbox: new browser context; visit once, await service worker, set offline, then reload

claim: The desktop engine opens and profiles CSV, JSON, JSON Lines, and Parquet files
sandbox: temporary local CSV, JSON, JSON Lines, and shipped Parquet fixture; assert rows, headers, and profiles

claim: Profiles report numeric minimum and maximum values correctly
where: landing profile description and desktop profile rail
sandbox: temporary integer and decimal values 2, 10, 100 and shipped sample-scale decimals

claim: Parquet strings and missing values can be profiled, filtered, and exported
sandbox: three-row shipped regression fixture with keep/null/drop strings; assert preview, profile, filter, and CSV bytes

claim: The desktop app applies named filters, derived columns, renames, and selections
sandbox: ordered source fixture; apply filter, derived column, rename, and selection, then inspect the result

claim: The native engine can join local reference data by a named key
sandbox: two temporary local CSVs; assert named-key join columns and unmatched blank cells

claim: Recipes save and reopen as portable JSON with source identity and ordered steps
sandbox: serialize and reopen a recipe fixture, then replay its ordered filter

claim: The desktop app exports matching rows beyond its 100-row preview
sandbox: 101-row CSV; filter amount greater than 99; assert rows 100 and 101 are written

claim: Saving the same recipe again does not consume another free recipe slot
sandbox: browser app demo; save the unchanged recipe twice and inspect its isolated saved-recipe keys

claim: The free desk saves three unique recipes and rejects a fourth
where: landing free-desk section and desktop paid-access dialog
sandbox: browser app demo; save three distinct local recipes, then verify the fourth opens the unavailable-paid-access notice

claim: CSV transforms remain free while paid JSON Lines export and joins are withheld
sandbox: browser app demo; inspect CSV availability and attempt a join

claim: Leaving the desktop demo discards its isolated storage
sandbox: browser app demo; seed demo storage, start for real, then assert no demo namespace remains

claim: Landing navigation and important controls are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels
where: landing header, downloads, and desktop toolbar
sandbox: desktop and 390px browser projects; measure wordmark, navigation, download, license, and add-step controls

claim: The Linux installer command can receive keyboard focus and has an accessible label
sandbox: desktop and 390px landing pages; focus the labelled scroll region and run Axe

claim: One-line installers verify SHA-256 before installing
sandbox: read both shipped installer scripts and assert their platform hash verification commands

claim: SHA256SUMS completely verifies every listed release asset without a self-entry
sandbox: temporary release asset; build manifest and run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

claim: Published release metadata and checksums identify the immutable source revision for every platform package
where: release workflow, landing download state, and release metadata
sandbox: inspect workflow for pinned tag resolution, per-job build ID injection, provenance, and checksum publication

claim: Unsigned macOS and Windows packages are labelled as unsigned before download
where: landing downloads section and installer scripts
sandbox: mock a matching release with unsigned macOS and Windows packages; assert package links and explicit status text

claim: No checkout or license verification is offered before signed desktop releases are verified
where: landing free-desk section, app dialog, privacy, and terms
sandbox: mock unsigned release; inspect site and app for the unavailable state and absence of checkout or token controls

claim: A selected browser-workbench fixture is not sent to another origin
where: landing privacy section, desktop privacy note, and privacy page
sandbox: record requests while opening, filtering, and exporting a selected fixture; assert only browser-app origin and no fixture content

claim: Landing load makes no behavioral-analytics request
sandbox: record landing requests with mocked release metadata; assert only same-origin assets and the GitHub release API

claim: Desktop installers include application and native license notices
sandbox: clean Ubuntu worker provisions Tauri packages, builds a Debian installer, and asserts LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, and Apache-2.0.txt

claim: Built site and desktop app show their version and immutable source revision
sandbox: development build injects the current Git revision; assert both footers omit the source-checkout placeholder
